Sir,

Sir,

Date June 14, 1930:
Subject (in full) Konstanty Lutowitez.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**
With reference to the attached letter of June 10,
1930 from Consulate General for the Netherlands re:
Konstanty Lutowitez, inquiries show that he resides at
744 Avenue Joffre, where he owns the ladies salon "Monique."
K. Lutowitez is a native of Covno (formerly part of Russia,
now Poland), was born in 1893 and educated at a commercial
school in Covno. From 1912 to 1916 he lived at Kiev, South
Russia, where he studied in a Politechnic high school.
In 1916 he was mobilized in the Russian Army and joined the
Kiev Military School. In 1917 Lutowitez was promoted to
Commissioned rank and sent to Kazan for a course in gas
warfare. In 1918 when the Whites took Kazan, he joined the
White Russian Army and retreated with them to Novo-Nikolaevsk,
Siberia. In this place he received a Polish passport and left
the Army. He later arrived in Harbin and was employed there
as a teacher in a middle school. In May 1919 Lutowitez
left Harbin for Shanghai, and from 1919 to 1926 he was
employed at the "China Soap Co." Yangtzepoo. In 1927 he
re-opened his present business the "Salon Monique."
It is not known that he is in any way connected with
Bolsheviks, and there is nothing in Police records to his
detriment.
D. Tcheremshansky
D. S.
D. C.
(C. & S. Branches)
Reg

报告
日期：1930年6月14日：
事由（全称）Konstanty Lutowitez。
由副督察 Tcheremshansky 撰写。由 **〔此处转录不清〕** 转呈。
关于随附的1930年6月10日荷兰总领事馆关于 Konstanty Lutowitez 的来信，经查，他居住在霞飞路744号，并拥有名为“Monique”的女士美容院。K. Lutowitez 是科夫诺（Covno，原属俄罗斯，现属波兰）人，生于1893年，曾在科夫诺的一所商业学校受教育。1912年至1916年间，他居住在俄罗斯南部的基辅，并在一所理工高中就读。1916年，他在俄国军队中被征召入伍，并加入基辅军事学校。1917年，Lutowitez 晋升为委任军官，并被派往喀山参加毒气战课程。1918年白军占领喀山时，他加入俄国白军，并随他们撤退至西伯利亚的新尼古拉耶夫斯克（Novo-Nikolaevsk）。在那里，他获得了波兰护照并离开了军队。随后他抵达哈尔滨，并在那里的一所中学担任教师。1919年5月，Lutowitez 离开哈尔滨前往上海，1919年至1926年间，他在杨树浦的“中国肥皂公司”（China Soap Co.）任职。1927年，他重新开设了目前的生意“Salon Monique”。
据查，他与布尔什维克没有任何关联，警方档案中亦无任何对其不利的记录。
D. Tcheremshansky
副督察
助理处长
（刑事及特科）
登记室
